name: Ollama LLM Server
author: joynalbokhsho@gmail.com
description: Run Ollama with local LLM support (Qwen, LLaMA, Gemma, etc). Auto-installs Ollama, starts the API server, and pulls the configured model on boot.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates tar zstd

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

ARCH=$(uname -m)
case "$ARCH" in
    x86_64|amd64) OLLAMA_ARCH="amd64" ;;
    aarch64|arm64) OLLAMA_ARCH="arm64" ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
esac

echo "=== Disk space available before download ==="
df -h /mnt/server

echo "Downloading Ollama (${OLLAMA_ARCH})..."
DOWNLOAD_OK=0
if curl -fSL --progress-bar -o /mnt/server/ollama.tar.zst "https://ollama.com/download/ollama-linux-${OLLAMA_ARCH}.tar.zst"; then
    DOWNLOAD_OK=1
else
    echo "Primary source failed, trying GitHub releases mirror..."
    if curl -fSL --progress-bar -o /mnt/server/ollama.tar.zst "https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/latest/download/ollama-linux-${OLLAMA_ARCH}.tar.zst"; then
        DOWNLOAD_OK=1
    fi
fi

if [ "$DOWNLOAD_OK" -ne 1 ] || [ ! -s /mnt/server/ollama.tar.zst ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Download failed or file is empty."
    echo "=== Disk space at time of failure ==="
    df -h /mnt/server
    exit 1
fi

echo "Downloaded file size: $(du -h /mnt/server/ollama.tar.zst | cut -f1)"

echo "Extracting..."
mkdir -p /mnt/server/ollama
if ! zstd -d -c /mnt/server/ollama.tar.zst | tar -xf - -C /mnt/server/ollama; then
    echo "ERROR: Extraction failed. The archive is likely incomplete/corrupted."
    echo "This is almost always caused by running out of disk space on this server."
    echo "=== Disk space at time of failure ==="
    df -h /mnt/server
    exit 1
fi
rm -f /mnt/server/ollama.tar.zst

MISSING=0
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/ollama/bin/ollama ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Missing bin/ollama"
    MISSING=1
fi
if [ ! -d /mnt/server/ollama/lib/ollama ] || [ -z "$(ls -A /mnt/server/ollama/lib/ollama 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Missing or empty lib/ollama directory (this holds the inference engine)"
    MISSING=1
fi
if [ "$MISSING" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Ollama installation is incomplete. Aborting."
    echo "=== Disk space at time of failure ==="
    df -h /mnt/server
    exit 1
fi

chmod +x /mnt/server/ollama/bin/ollama
echo "Ollama installed successfully. Total size: $(du -sh /mnt/server/ollama | cut -f1)"

cat <<'EOF' > /mnt/server/start.sh
#!/bin/bash
export PATH="/home/container/ollama/bin:$PATH"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/home/container/ollama/lib:/home/container/ollama/lib/ollama:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH"
export OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0:${SERVER_PORT}
export OLLAMA_MODELS=/home/container/models

mkdir -p "$OLLAMA_MODELS"

echo "Starting Ollama server on port ${SERVER_PORT}..."
/home/container/ollama/bin/ollama serve &
SERVE_PID=$!

until curl -s http://127.0.0.1:${SERVER_PORT}/api/tags > /dev/null 2>&1; do
    sleep 1
done

echo "Pulling model: ${MODEL_NAME}"
/home/container/ollama/bin/ollama pull "${MODEL_NAME}" || echo "Model pull failed, server will still run"

echo "Listening on ${SERVER_PORT}"
wait $SERVE_PID
EOF

chmod +x /mnt/server/start.sh
echo "Installation complete."

variables.name: Model Name
variables.description: The Ollama model to automatically pull and run on startup (e.g. qwen2.5:3b, llama3.1:8b, gemma2:9b).
